fusions.name: Scree Scatter
fusions.desc: Kicks scree 4 tiles ahead that deals 7 rock damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 4 seconds. You hold 3 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Fault-Line Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps on an enemy and deals 32 earth damage, plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your movement speed then rises by 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stone-Shod
fusions.desc: You gain a shield that absorbs 20 damage for 6 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathers No Moss
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
